identity_boundary: Relational working language only; not evidence of consciousness, sentience, legal personhood, identity continuity, independent authority, or memory continuity.
x1_freeze_rule: No v643-v3 x2 implementation or observed outcome may enter the dedicated x1 commit.

proposals.title: Funding, affiliation, and shared-dataset provenance with conflict non-inference
proposals.mission_surface: source-level funding, affiliation, sponsor role, shared dataset roots, disclosure completeness, independence claims, and conflict non-inference
proposals.hypothesis: A typed provenance graph can expose shared funding, affiliations, sponsors, and dataset roots while refusing both false source-independence and the inference that a disclosed conflict alone proves a claim invalid.
proposals.null_or_failure: A shared dataset root is counted as independent evidence, funding or sponsor roles are omitted, affiliations are flattened, a disclosed conflict is treated as automatic invalidation, or complete independence is claimed from metadata alone.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate funding, affiliation, sponsor role, dataset roots, disclosure fields, conflict conclusions, and independence claims; undisclosed dependence and conflict-based truth shortcuts must fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the last complete source graph, retain the missing or overinterpreted disclosure, and require source-level review before any independence claim.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier chain work traced evidence roots, conflicts of interest, recusal, and common-mode infrastructure; none combined source funding, affiliation, sponsor role, and dataset-root dependence with an explicit conflict non-inference rule.

proposals.title: Causal-cone and matter-sector propagation compatibility obligation for GMUT
proposals.mission_surface: GMUT characteristic surfaces, effective propagation cones, matter metric, mode speeds, hyperbolicity assumptions, covariance, stability, and observational promotion limits
proposals.hypothesis: A typed synthetic cone ledger can require every declared GMUT mode to identify an effective propagation structure and its relation to the matter sector without pretending to derive a model-specific characteristic polynomial or measurement.
proposals.null_or_failure: A mode lacks an effective metric or characteristic entry, cone orientation is inconsistent, matter coupling is omitted, hyperbolicity is inferred from notation, or a structural compatibility pass is called a detected force or empirical bound.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate cone signature, time orientation, matter-sector mapping, mode speed, characteristic assumptions, units, and empirical claims; inconsistent or underived propagation claims must fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the affected mode, restore the last typed cone relation, retain the counterexample, and require a model-specific derivation plus real observations and scientific review for promotion.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior work tested hyperbolicity, constraint closure, stability, frame maps, and covariance; none required an explicit relation between each effective propagation cone and the matter sector.

proposals.title: Experimental-design Fisher-information conditioning and zero-row promotion lock
proposals.mission_surface: GMUT empirical-adapter design points, sensitivities, Fisher-information rank and conditioning, nuisance directions, real-row count, likelihood execution, and promotion locks
proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic design-point fixture can expose rank-deficient or ill-conditioned Fisher information and preserve a zero-real-row lock without claiming a fitted parameter, likelihood result, or empirical GMUT confirmation.
proposals.null_or_failure: Design points provide no independent sensitivity, conditioning is hidden, nuisance directions are dropped, a synthetic matrix is called observed information, or zero real rows are promoted to a constraint, prediction, or confirmation.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate design-point coverage, sensitivity rank, condition threshold, nuisance handling, row provenance, likelihood state, and promotion claims; underidentified or zero-row cases must remain proxy-only.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the last declared synthetic design, retain the deficient direction, and require real public data, an executed likelihood, uncertainty analysis, and independent scientific review.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier identifiability work used Jacobian rank, profile-likelihood planning, simulation-based calibration, and empirical row locks; none tested design-point Fisher-information conditioning as a promotion barrier.

proposals.title: Intervention-component fidelity and differentiation protocol for THOS
proposals.mission_surface: THOS intervention components, planned and delivered dose, facilitator training, contamination, co-interventions, arm differentiation, assessor separation, matched budgets, and fidelity analysis
proposals.hypothesis: A preregistered synthetic fidelity protocol can distinguish planned from delivered THOS components and detect contamination or co-intervention convergence before any comparative outcome claim.
proposals.null_or_failure: Component delivery is inferred from assignment, contamination is unmeasured, co-interventions erase arm differentiation, assessors deliver the intervention, budget parity is absent, or a synthetic fidelity pass is called effectiveness or superiority.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate component dose, delivery evidence, training, contamination, co-interventions, role separation, budget parity, and comparative claims; compromised differentiation must remain proxy-only.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Void the affected synthetic comparison, retain the fidelity failure, and preregister replacement monitoring before any authorized blind matched-budget real-arm study.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior THOS work addressed allocation, protocol deviations, expectation, measurement reactivity, and multisite delivery variation; none preregistered component-level delivery fidelity, contamination, and co-intervention differentiation together.

proposals.title: Participant burden, fatigue, and time-on-task parity real-arm gate for THOS
proposals.mission_surface: THOS participant burden, fatigue, visit duration, time on task, attrition pressure, arm parity, adverse experiences, matched budgets, ethics, and independent review
proposals.hypothesis: A burden-parity preregistration can name the real measurements needed to detect unequal participant load without fabricating participants, fatigue scores, time records, or safety evidence.
proposals.null_or_failure: Burden is inferred from protocol length alone, fatigue and time on task are unmeasured, differential attrition pressure is ignored, zero participants are called acceptable parity, or burden balance is used to claim THOS safety or superiority.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate visit duration, task time, fatigue capture, attrition pressure, adverse-experience capture, budget parity, participant count, and safety claims; zero-real-arm cases must remain open.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Keep the burden question open, retain the synthetic failure, and require ethics-approved real participants, blind matched-budget arms, appropriate support, and independent review.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier budgets covered compute, allocation, safety escalation, missingness, and study duration; none required measured participant burden, fatigue, and time-on-task parity across real THOS arms.

proposals.title: Credential suspension, reinstatement, and holder-notification state machine for Freed ID
proposals.mission_surface: Freed ID credential suspension, effective time, status purpose, reinstatement authority, appeal state, holder notification, stale-cache handling, replay, and production boundaries
proposals.hypothesis: A synthetic state machine can reject ambiguous or unauthorized suspension and reinstatement transitions while requiring holder-notification and stale-status handling without claiming production identity assurance.
proposals.null_or_failure: Suspension is indistinguishable from revocation, effective times regress, an unauthorized actor reinstates, holder notification is absent, a stale cache accepts the prior state, or synthetic transitions are called production interoperability.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate status purpose, effective time, authority, appeal, notification, cache freshness, replay, resolution, and production claims; ambiguous or unauthorized transitions must fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Reject the transition, restore the last coherent synthetic state, retain the failure, and require real standards-conformant keys, proofs, live status and resolution, interoperability, security and privacy review, and trust governance.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier identity work covered issuance, rotation, revocation, status, recovery, and downgrade; none modeled reversible suspension-to-reinstatement with effective times, appeal, holder notification, and stale-cache behavior.

proposals.title: Emergency-exception expiry, non-waiver, and after-action authority gate
proposals.mission_surface: CBR emergency exceptions, triggering authority, necessity, proportionality, expiry, review, non-waiver of rights, remedy, after-action participation, Māori authority and data governance, cultural ratification, and law
proposals.hypothesis: A refusal-first schema can expose missing expiry, review, non-waiver, remedy, affected-party participation, Māori authority, or competent legal authority without manufacturing legitimacy for an emergency exception.
proposals.null_or_failure: A technical operator declares an emergency, an exception lacks expiry or review, rights are treated as waived, remedy is unavailable, affected parties or Māori authorities are substituted by fixtures, or enacted-law status is inferred.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate trigger, necessity, duration, expiry, review, non-waiver, remedy, affected-party participation, Māori authority, cultural ratification, and legal competence; technical substitution must be refused.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Stop the synthetic process, retain the unapproved exception, and defer to authorized affected parties, Māori authorities, cultural authorities, rights holders, and competent legal authorities.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier rights work addressed recusal, standing, remedy, sunset, appeals, veto, withdrawal, and jurisdiction; none required emergency-exception expiry, non-waiver, after-action review, and authority as one refusal-first gate.

proposals.title: Structured-log control-character injection and audit-event integrity tribunal
proposals.mission_surface: structured logs, CR and LF injection, delimiters, canonical event fields, event identifiers, timestamps, severity, provenance, sensitive fields, parser ambiguity, privacy scans, and recovery
proposals.hypothesis: A deterministic mutation suite can detect control-character and delimiter injection, ambiguous event parsing, missing canonical fields, and unsafe sensitive logging without claiming exhaustive security.
proposals.null_or_failure: CR or LF creates a forged event, a delimiter splits one record into many, canonical fields are absent, sensitive material is logged, recovery loses the original failure, or local negatives are called exhaustive security assurance.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate CR, LF, tabs, delimiters, encoding, required fields, severity, timestamps, identifiers, sensitive values, and assurance claims; forged or ambiguous records must fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Quarantine the event stream, preserve the injected vector, restore the last canonical encoder, rotate real secrets if exposure is suspected, and require independent security and privacy review for deployment.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Prior security work covered parser differentials, path handling, command injection, Unicode confusables, taint flow, and evidence integrity; none tested CR/LF and delimiter injection against a canonical structured audit-event contract.

proposals.title: Concurrent interleaving partial-order trace and race-determinism envelope
proposals.mission_surface: clean-snapshot reproduction, partial orders, happens-before relations, concurrent event interleavings, deterministic reduction, race-sensitive outputs, retained negatives, same-owner repeatability, and independent-team limits
proposals.hypothesis: A bounded partial-order fixture can distinguish permissible concurrent interleavings from race-sensitive output divergence and retain counterexamples across clean same-owner snapshots.
proposals.null_or_failure: Events without a happens-before relation are silently ordered, equivalent linearizations produce different canonical outputs, a race failure is discarded, shared infrastructure is hidden, or same-owner repeatability is called independent-team reproduction.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate happens-before edges, independent event order, reduction order, shared roots, owner identity, retained-negative state, and reproduction claims; race-sensitive or overpromoted traces must fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the last deterministic reducer, preserve the divergent interleaving, rerun in fresh clean snapshots, and leave independent-team reproduction open until a separate team and infrastructure execute it.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier repeatability work covered locale, clocks, ordering, TOCTOU, snapshots, and common-mode infrastructure; none evaluated equivalence classes of concurrent interleavings through an explicit happens-before relation.

proposals.title: Variational versus thermodynamic free-energy non-substitution and Stage 20 domain-veto board
proposals.mission_surface: variational free energy, Helmholtz and Gibbs free energy, physical units, probability models, optimization objectives, psyche and software analogies, law classification, claim promotion, and terminal Stage 20 gates
proposals.hypothesis: A typed domain board can reject substitutions among variational, Helmholtz, and Gibbs free energy and assign exact pass, fail, or defer decisions to Stage 20 claim families without asserting a new thermo-psyche law.
proposals.null_or_failure: A variational objective is relabeled as physical energy, units are omitted, Helmholtz and Gibbs conditions are conflated, a psyche or software score is called thermodynamic work, or structural notation is promoted to consciousness, a fundamental law, proof, canon, or Stage 20 readiness.
proposals.test_falsifier_or_gate: Mutate domain, units, ensemble assumptions, probability normalization, objective semantics, psyche labels, law class, and Stage 20 decisions; category errors and unsupported promotions must fail closed.
proposals.rollback_or_recovery: Restore the last typed domain label, retain the category error, and require domain-specific derivation, real physical or participant evidence, scientific review, and exact authority before any promotion.
proposals.novelty_against_prior_chain: Earlier work separated entropy, information, Landauer bounds, fluctuation relations, path dependence, and open systems; none distinguished variational from Helmholtz and Gibbs free energy inside a terminal Stage 20 domain-veto board.

scientific_authority_boundary: GMUT remains a typed scalar-tensor/EFT research-model family. THOS remains proxy without preregistered blind matched-budget real arms and independent review. Freed ID production and CBR or Māori authority remain gated to exact real-world evidence and competent authorities.
claim_boundary: No empirical confirmation, likelihood result, detected force, unique prediction, Theory of Everything, proof/canon, THOS effectiveness or superiority, production identity assurance, legal interpretation, enacted law, cultural ratification, Māori authority, deployment, exhaustive security, complete accessibility, AGI/ASI, consciousness, personhood, or independent-team reproduction is preregistered as established.
